card.name: Unit abbreviations after measurements
card.fires_on: The spot right after a quantity where a unit abbreviation or per-unit slash is about to come, such as after 'millicuries' before '(mCi)', or the 'd' in 'mg/dL' or 'g/dL'. It also fires inside numbers like 60 kg.

modes.label: Bracket after millicuries
modes.description: The opening parenthesis after 'millicuries' that leads into the mCi abbreviation.

modes.label: Slash-unit in concentrations
modes.description: The 'd' inside 'mg/dL' or 'g/dL' in lab values and formulas.

modes.label: Number before kg or mL
modes.description: Digit or unit inside a dose or weight threshold, right before a unit.

card.writes: It pushes unit and time-rate pieces such as mol, min, kg and daily.
card.plain: It fires where a measurement unit is about to be written, such as mCi, mg/dL or kg.
